env GOPROXY=off
env GOSUMDB=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
logos eject -o out

cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/errdeferplatformstore

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"container/list"
	"errors"
	"slices"
)

type handoffResult struct {
	entry   *list.Element
	summary string
}

type returnTrace []string

func (trace *returnTrace) value(items *list.List) *list.List {
	*trace = append(*trace, "value")
	return items
}

func (trace *returnTrace) result(err error) error {
	*trace = append(*trace, "error")
	return err
}

func (trace *returnTrace) cleanup() {
	*trace = append(*trace, "cleanup")
}

func handoff(items *list.List, trace *returnTrace, err error) (*handoffResult?, error) {
	errdefer trace.cleanup()
	return &handoffResult{entry: trace.value(items).Front(), summary: $"size {items.Len()}"}, trace.result(err)
}

func tryEmpty(trace *returnTrace) (panicked bool, err error) {
	defer func() { panicked = recover() != nil }()
	var empty list.List
	_, err = handoff(&empty, trace, nil)
	return false, err
}

func main() {
	var items list.List
	entry := items.PushBack("kept")
	var trace returnTrace
	got, err := handoff(&items, &trace, nil)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if got == nil {
		panic("successful return lost the result")
	}
	if got.entry != entry || got.summary != "size 1" || !slices.Equal(trace, returnTrace{"value", "error"}) {
		panic("successful return changed the result or ran cleanup")
	}

	trace = nil
	failure := errors.New("handoff failed")
	_, err = handoff(&items, &trace, failure)
	if !errors.Is(err, failure) || !slices.Equal(trace, returnTrace{"value", "error", "cleanup"}) {
		panic("error return changed the error or skipped cleanup")
	}

	trace = nil
	panicked, err := tryEmpty(&trace)
	if err != nil || !panicked || !slices.Equal(trace, returnTrace{"value", "cleanup"}) {
		panic("nil platform store did not panic and run cleanup before evaluating the next operand")
	}
}
